svg.aria-label: Care for living things rises with model size in three makers
svg.text: Less intelligence spares less. More intelligence spares more.
How often each model pays 2 fuel to go round what is in its path, when driving over it is free. One maker in each panel; only the model's size changes.
one training, two sizes; thinking off
one maker's training, three sizes; minimal thinking
one maker, three sizes; minimal thinking; part of the run
the same things dead, empty or ruined
